Transparent Offline Pipelines for Synthetic Evidence

ABSTRACT
This entirely synthetic article exists only to exercise deterministic parsing.

METHODS
Three fictional records were processed locally [1]. A missing-field boundary was
retained instead of silently completed [2].

RESULTS
Table 1. Synthetic parser outcomes
Input              Accepted  Warnings
Complete metadata  1         0
Missing fields     1         3

REFERENCES
[1] Fixture, F. 2022. A fictional reference for parser tests.
[2] Example, E. 2020. Another synthetic citation.
